neighbours.label: first fragment of a word split into several tokens, where the rest of the word is predictable (hav|ens, scour|ges, di|aries, sound|tracks)
fire: Remote islands have become havens for smugglers.
Cholera was one of the oldest scourges of crowded cities.
The astronauts kept weekly audio diaries during the mission.
She listens to film soundtracks while she studies.
Most people leave digital footprints wherever they go online.
The lab measures proteomic and metabolomic changes in blood.
The old fort was surrounded by deep, muddy ramparts.
Their lab studies the pathogenesis of rare infections.
quiet: Remote islands have become home for smugglers.
Cholera was one of the oldest threats to crowded cities.
The astronauts kept weekly written notes during the mission.
She listens to film music while she studies.
Most people leave traces wherever they go online.
The lab measures protein and sugar changes in blood.
The old fort was surrounded by deep, muddy walls.
Their lab studies the causes of rare infections.

notes: card flags broad (1.0%); top examples are word-initial pieces of multi-token words
